body.name: Confidence-set image construction
body.construction: Given a simultaneous \((1-\alpha)\)-confidence region \(\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\) for \(\mu\), set \(J_{n,\alpha}=[\inf_{v\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\cap\mathcal V_{L,\kappa}}\pi_1\phi(v),\ \sup_{v\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\cap\mathcal V_{L,\kappa}}\pi_2\phi(v)]\) when the intersection is nonempty and set \(J_{n,\alpha}=[0,1]\) otherwise. Equivalently, the extrema are over \(H_-(v)=\pi_1\phi(v)\) and \(H_+(v)=\pi_2\phi(v)\), both defined on \(\mathcal V_{L,\kappa}\). The known implementation-level containment \(v\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}\Rightarrow[H_-(v),H_+(v)]\subseteq J_{n,\alpha}\) is merely the image-of-a-covered-set observation and carries no separate proof obligation or novelty claim.
